content.text:
121 listings match "search", auth sign-in, showing the first 8. Call get_server with a slug for the endpoint URL or install command and setup steps.
- GitHub: Work with GitHub repos, issues, pull requests, Actions workflows and code search from your AI assistant. [slug github; remote, OAuth sign-in; verified] https://mcp.tc/i/github
- Notion: Search, read, create and update pages and databases in your Notion workspace from an MCP client. [slug notion; remote, OAuth sign-in; verified] https://mcp.tc/i/notion
- Cloudflare API (Cloudflare): Search and call the full Cloudflare API (2,500+ endpoints) through a few Code Mode tools, plus Cloudflare docs search. [slug cloudflare; remote, OAuth sign-in; verified] https://mcp.tc/i/cloudflare
- Hugging Face: Search Hugging Face Hub models, datasets, Spaces and papers, and browse repo files and trending lists from your assistant. [slug hugging-face; remote, sign-in optional; verified] https://mcp.tc/i/hugging-face
- Stripe: Work with Stripe customers, products, payments, invoices and subscriptions, and search Stripe docs, from your AI assistant. [slug stripe; remote, OAuth sign-in; verified] https://mcp.tc/i/stripe
- FullEnrich: Search B2B contacts, enrich verified emails and phone numbers, and export results as CSV or JSON. [slug fullenrich; remote, OAuth sign-in] https://mcp.tc/i/fullenrich
- Ref: Search public and private documentation and read pages as markdown while using as few tokens as possible. [slug ref-tools; remote, API key] https://mcp.tc/i/ref-tools
- Smartsheet: Read and update Smartsheet sheets, search workspaces, and manage folders and discussions in natural language. [slug smartsheet; remote, OAuth sign-in] https://mcp.tc/i/smartsheet
More: https://mcp.tc/directory?q=search&s=auth&sort=popular
